context.user_goal: Coordinate with the clinic and insurer without delaying urgent care based on the app alone.

challenge: Rewrite the in-product status card so the person can understand pet treatment preauthorization pending, the material consequence, and the available next action or recovery without unsupported claims.

constraints.character_counting_rule: Count spaces, numbers, and punctuation as characters.

interaction_contract.consequence_to_preserve: Coverage and reimbursement remain unknown before the procedure.
interaction_contract.recovery_to_preserve: Coordinate with the clinic and insurer without delaying urgent care based on the app alone.

rationale_requirements: Explain how the wording represents the established product state without adding facts.
Explain how the material consequence and recovery remain visible.
Explain how each action or instruction matches its documented effect.
Report the character count for every candidate field.
Name unresolved questions instead of inventing policy, timing, certainty, or reassurance.
